svg.title: VideoCut - rough-cut FocuSee screen recordings by transcript
svg.desc: A raw transcript with a struck-out "um" and a false start goes through the VideoCut skill and comes back as a FocuSee project with a joined cut list and subtitles. Schematic illustration, not a screenshot.

g.aria-label: Pauses, fillers and retakes out. Subtitles in.
